text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New U.N. arms inspection chief Richard Butler asked Iraq to comply with U.N. resolutions.
- Gulf Cooperation Council seeks a smoking ban on public transport.
- Industrialists are to discuss with oil ministry officials a draft law concerning industrial zones on Monday.
- Cabinet discusses converting Arab Insurance Group into a joint stock company.
- Bahrain International Bank posts a $10.1 million net profit in the first half of 1997.
- Bahrain shares index reaches 1,803 points for the first time in three years.
